subject: Reactive only for particular text input

messages.author: f923f5395925a18d
messages.subject: Reactive only for particular text input
parts:
I'm currently trying to have my plot reload only if the user inputs text that is within a preloaded set of appropriate texts.
If the input is not within that set of appropriate texts, the plot should remain as is, and preferably a note would pop up that would ask for a different input.
I tried using eventObserve and eventReactive, using something like this:

text<- eventReactive(input$text %in% c(x,y), function() {
      [insert function here]
    })

Obviously, I've simplified here, but the overall gist is there. The renderPlot function depends on this reactive function, so whenever this reactive function changes the plot reloads.
However, if the output of the reactive function is not appropriate, it causes the plot to break.
The problem I'm having is that eventReactive reacts even if input$text isn't x or y and eventObserve won't allow me to have a function within it.
Any thoughts?

Thanks,
Will

messages.author: e1656d208b1207ce
messages.subject: Re: Reactive only for particular text input
parts:
You can achieve the desired behavior with reactiveValues (it's a really powerful construct in shiny). Here's what it looks like:

inputText <- reactiveValues(value="")
observe({
  if(input$text %in% c(x,y)) inputText$value <- input$text
})

text<- eventReactive(inputText$value, function() {
  [insert function here]
})
